title: Elevator Requests II
statement: An elevator starts at floor start in a building whose floors are numbered 0 to n - 1, and every requested floor is issued simultaneously at time 0. The elevator moves exactly one floor per second, up or down, and a request is fulfilled the instant the elevator reaches that floor, contributing its fulfilment time to the total penalty. The requested floors are all distinct, and a request on the starting floor is fulfilled at time 0. Return the minimum achievable sum of fulfilment times over all requests.
